User.title: User
User.description: Represents a registered user in the EduVerse platform, primarily identified by their phone number. This entity stores core user information and links to their personalized data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

phoneNumber.description: The unique phone number registered by the user. This serves as a primary identifier for user login and tracking within the application context.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's most recent successful login or access attempt.

loginCount.description: The total number of times this phone number has successfully logged in.

UserAccessLog.title: UserAccessLog
UserAccessLog.description: Records each instance of a user attempting to register or access the website via the phone number and OTP mechanism. This is used for administrative tracking, security auditing, and analytics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserAccessLog entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User associated with this access attempt. (Relationship: User 1:N UserAccessLog).

phoneNumber.description: The phone number entered by the user during this attempt.

otpEntered.description: The 4-digit OTP entered by the user during this attempt. Stored for logging and auditing purposes, not for re-authentication.

accessTimestamp.description: Date and time of the access or registration attempt.

isSuccessful.description: Indicates if the access or registration attempt was successful (e.g., OTP matched, user successfully registered/logged in).

eventType.description: Describes the type of event, such as 'InitialRegistration', 'LoginAttempt', 'FirstTimeVisitPrompt', or 'FailedLogin'.

Curriculum.title: Curriculum
Curriculum.description: Represents a distinct educational curriculum or exam board offered by EduVerse (e.g., CBSE Board, NIOS Board, SSC Exams).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Curriculum entity.

name.description: The official name of the curriculum or exam board (e.g., 'CBSE Board', 'NIOS Board', 'SSC Exams').

description.description: A detailed description of the curriculum, its scope, and target audience.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject or a specific exam category offered within a particular curriculum.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

name.description: The name of the subject (e.g., 'Mathematics', 'General Awareness', 'Physics').

description.description: A brief description of the subject or exam category content.

curriculumId.description: Reference to the Curriculum this subject belongs to. (Relationship: Curriculum 1:N Subject).

gradeLevel.description: The academic grade or class level for which this subject is relevant (e.g., 4 for Class 4, 12 for Class 12). Only applicable to academic curricula.

LearningContent.title: LearningContent
LearningContent.description: Represents a distinct piece of educational material available on the platform, such as a lesson, video, article, or practice test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LearningContent entity.

title.description: The title of the learning content.

description.description: A short summary or description of the content.

contentType.description: The format or type of the content (e.g., 'Video', 'TextArticle', 'Quiz', 'PracticeTest', 'Document').

url.description: The URL to access the learning content resource, if applicable.

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject this content belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N LearningContent).

difficultyLevel.description: An indicator of the content's difficulty (e.g., 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

durationMinutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes for consuming the content (e.g., video length, estimated reading time).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the learning content was first added to the platform.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the learning content was last updated.

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Represents a personalized study plan generated for a user by the AI, outlining their learning path and goals.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User for whom this study plan is created. (Relationship: User 1:N StudyPlan).

planName.description: A descriptive name for the study plan (e.g., 'My CBSE Class 10 Math Plan', 'SSC CGL Prep').

description.description: A detailed description of the study plan's objectives and scope.

startDate.description: The planned start date for the study plan.

endDate.description: The planned end date for the study plan.

status.description: The current status of the study plan (e.g., 'Active', 'Completed', 'Paused', 'Archived').

goal.description: The primary learning goal associated with this study plan (e.g., 'Master Algebra', 'Pass RRB Exam').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was initially generated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was last modified or updated.

contentIds.description: An ordered list of LearningContent IDs that form part of this study plan. (Relationship: StudyPlan N:N LearningContent).

UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Tracks a user's progress and performance on individual pieces of learning content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProgress entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User whose progress is being tracked. (Relationship: User 1:N UserProgress).

contentId.description: Reference to the LearningContent on which progress is being tracked. (Relationship: LearningContent 1:N UserProgress).

status.description: The current progress status of the user on this content (e.g., 'NotStarted', 'InProgress', 'Completed').

score.description: The score obtained by the user for quizzes or tests associated with this content.

lastAccessedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user interacted with this learning content.

completionPercentage.description: A percentage indicating how much of the content the user has completed (e.g., 0-100).

timeSpentSeconds.description: The total cumulative time in seconds the user has spent engaging with this specific content.

definition.description: Root collection for user profiles. Each document represents a unique user, identified by their Firebase Authentication UID or phone number hash. Includes core user information and serves as the parent for user-specific subcollections. Authorization is path-based: `request.auth.uid` must match `{userId}`.
Subcollection storing personalized study plans for each user. Documents include the `userId` field, which must match the `{userId}` wildcard in the path for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this study plan. Corresponds to Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: studyPlanId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific study plan.

definition.description: Subcollection tracking a user's progress on various learning content. Documents include the `userId` field, which must match the `{userId}` wildcard in the path for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user whose progress is being tracked. Corresponds to Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: progressId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user progress record.

definition.description: Top-level collection for all educational curricula offered (e.g., CBSE, NIOS, SSC Exams). Publicly readable. Admin-only write access.

params.name: curriculumId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific curriculum.

definition.description: Subcollection for academic subjects or exam categories within a specific curriculum. Documents include `curriculumId` to explicitly link to their parent. Publicly readable. Admin-only write access.

params.name: curriculumId
params.description: The unique identifier of the curriculum this subject belongs to.

params.name: subjectId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific subject.

definition.description: Top-level collection for all learning materials (videos, articles, quizzes). Designed for efficient global querying by AI/recommendation systems. Documents include `subjectId` for linkage. Publicly readable. Admin-only write access.

params.name: contentId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific piece of learning content.

definition.description: Top-level collection for recording all user registration and access attempts. This is an admin-only collection for auditing, analytics, and tracking website engagement. Documents are self-contained with `phoneNumber`, `otpEntered`, `accessTimestamp`, `isSuccessful`, `eventType`, and optionally `userId`. Write access is exclusively by server-side logic (e.g., Cloud Functions). Read access is restricted to administrators.

params.name: logId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user access log entry.

definition.description: A collection used for Database Access Control (DBAC) to define system administrators. The mere existence of a document with `adminId` matching a user's UID grants administrative privileges. This avoids custom claims and supports Authorization Independence. Documents can be empty or contain a simple flag like `{ 'isAdmin': true }`. Only admins can read/write to this collection. (Note: Using User schema here as a placeholder for a generic user type if a dedicated AdminRole schema isn't provided, implying the User entity can be a member of this role.)

params.name: adminId
params.description: The unique identifier of a user designated as an administrator. Corresponds to Firebase Auth UID.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability. 

**Authorization Independence:**
*   **User-Owned Data (`/users/{userId}`, `/users/{userId}/studyPlans/{studyPlanId}`, `/users/{userId}/userProgress/{progressId}`):** These collections leverage path-based ownership. The `userId` in the document path (`/users/{userId}/...`) directly corresponds to `request.auth.uid` for authenticated users. This design eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules to check parent document ownership, making rules atomic and simplifying their logic. The `userId` field is also included in `StudyPlan` and `UserProgress` documents, further ensuring self-contained authorization context.
*   **Public Data (`/curriculums/{curriculumId}`, `/curriculums/{curriculumId}/subjects/{subjectId}`, `/learningContents/{contentId}`):** These collections are designed for public read access. Their authorization is inherently independent as they do not rely on user-specific permissions or parent document attributes for basic access. Write access is restricted to administrators.
*   **Admin-Only Data (`/userAccessLogs/{logId}`, `/roles_admin/{adminId}`):** Access to `userAccessLogs` is determined by the `roles_admin` collection. An admin's UID needs to exist in `/roles_admin/{adminId}`. This check is a simple `exists()` call, which is performant and independent of complex hierarchical data dependencies. The `UserAccessLog` documents are self-contained with all necessary audit information.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
*   **User-Owned Data:** For `/users/{userId}/studyPlans` and `/users/{userId}/userProgress`, `list` operations are implicitly filtered by the path (`userId == request.auth.uid`). This ensures that users can only list their own resources, adhering to QAPs without needing complex query filters in rules.
*   **Public Data:** For `/curriculums`, `/curriculums/{curriculumId}/subjects`, and `/learningContents`, all users are allowed to `list` documents, as the data is intended to be publicly discoverable. This directly supports QAPs as the rules grant access to the entire collection if the user is authorized for public content.
*   **Admin-Only Data:** For `/userAccessLogs`, `list` operations are restricted to authenticated administrators (checked via `/roles_admin`). Administrators are permitted to `list` all documents in this collection, fulfilling QAPs for an audit log where the full dataset is intended for administrative review.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   Publicly accessible educational content (Curriculum, Subject, LearningContent) is segregated from private user data (User, StudyPlan, UserProgress) and administrative logs (UserAccessLog, roles_admin). This clear separation simplifies security rules, as each collection or subcollection generally maintains a homogeneous security posture.
*   `UserAccessLog` is a top-level collection, specifically for audit purposes, separating it from standard user data or content. This ensures that sensitive login/access attempts are managed under distinct, admin-focused security rules.
